mapper.sql: id, order_no, buyer_id, seller_id, book_id, book_title, book_price, quantity, total_amount, address, status, pay_time, ship_time, finish_time, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (order_no, buyer_id, seller_id, book_id, book_title, book_price, quantity, total_amount, address, status) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{buyerId}, #{sellerId}, #{bookId}, #{bookTitle}, #{bookPrice}, #{quantity}, #{totalAmount}, #{address}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT o.id, o.order_no, o.buyer_id, o.seller_id, o.book_id, o.book_title, o.book_price, o.quantity, o.total_amount, o.address, o.status, o.pay_time, o.ship_time, o.finish_time, o.create_time, o.update_time, b.nickname AS buyer_name, s.nickname AS seller_name FROM orders o LEFT JOIN user b ON o.buyer_id = b.id LEFT JOIN user s ON o.seller_id = s.id WHERE o.id = #{id}
